sanskrit_verse: यं चार्थं प्रतिभूर् दद्याद् धनिकेनोपपीडितः। ऋणिकस् तं प्रतिभुवे द्विगुणं प्रतिपादयेत्।।
transliteration: yaṃ cārthaṃ pratibhūr dadyād dhanikenopapīḍitaḥ | ṛṇikas taṃ pratibhuve dviguṇaṃ pratipādayet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When a debtor, pressured by the creditor, delivers any asset as security, the creditor must return twice that asset to the debtor upon fulfillment of the debt.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from capacity to fulfill, not coercion
Causation aligns with conscious obligation discharge
Restoration logic requires doubling of value to realign consciousness
Consciousness alignment occurs through voluntary completion
executable_legal_axioms: IF a debtor provides collateral under pressure THEN the creditor MUST return double the value upon settlement
IF a transaction originates from imbalance THEN restoration MUST exceed original value
IF a party demonstrates capacity deficiency THEN system MUST facilitate integrity restoration
IF completion is initiated THEN punitive interference is NULL
IF restitution doubles value THEN consciousness equilibrium is restored
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, when evaluating secured transactions under duress, the threshold of responsibility lies in identifying coercive influence. The authority of the court is to enforce doubling of restitution, ensuring that economic imbalance does not perpetuate spiritual dissonance. This upholds Dharma by prioritizing consciousness realignment over material compensation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that imbalance manifests through diminished capacity. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that doubling restores sequential harmony. Proportional responsibility reflects the causal depth of coercion. The non-punitive reality rule confirms that suffering is not justice; completion and consciousness expansion are.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process by verifying original coercive condition
Assume responsibility for value doubling through institutional mechanism
Restore debtor's capacity via surplus return
Reintegrate creditor's integrity through mandatory restitution protocol
Verify consciousness alignment post-process through declared satisfaction
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law is established: Dharma prevails through conscious doubling, not punitive reduction. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the Supreme Adjudicator.
